ITEM 1 | Scrambled eggs, pale yellow with mixed deeper yellow curds, soft and fluffy, crumbly clusters spread over the upper right quadrant of the plate, slightly glossy where moist | 110
ITEM 2 | Cubed melon pieces in pale green (honeydew-like) and orange-salmon (cantaloupe-like) tones, firm with smooth flesh, roughly 2-3 cm cubes clustered upper left and center | 120
ITEM 3 | Orange-fleshed cubed fruit chunks, about 2-3 cm, firm with slightly glossy juicy surfaces, scattered center and right side | 70
ITEM 4 | Whole and halved strawberries, bright red with green calyx remnants, glossy and moist, some sliced into wedges, lower center of plate | 60
ITEM 5 | Blackberries, dark purple-black drupelets, plump and slightly glossy, several whole berries scattered across left and center | 30
ITEM 6 | Blueberries, small dark blue spheres with matte-to-slightly waxy skin, scattered center and right of the fruit cluster | 12
ITEM 7 | Raspberries and red berries, small clustered drupelets in deep red, soft and fragile, lower center near strawberries | 15
ITEM 8 | Mixed salad greens, dark green and reddish-purple leaves with wilted edges, lightly moist, covering the lower left of the plate under the fruit | 35
ITEM 9 | Fresh spinach-like leaves, bright green, flat and smooth, one prominent leaf on upper center of the fruit cluster | 8
ITEM 10 | Broccoli florets, dark green clustered tops with small buds, slightly moist, lower right near sweet potato | 25
ITEM 11 | Roasted sweet potato cubes, orange flesh with browned caramelized edges and darker crusty spots, firm and slightly glossy, lower right corner | 50
ITEM 12 | Cooked pale green cucumber or zucchini-like slices, translucent light green with soft flesh, upper left and center near melon | 20
